summit: Happiest Health Reimagining and Reforming Healthcare in India Summit 2026, Bengaluru
target_outcome: BP Decompensation (Progression to Stage 2 / New Diagnosis) within 365 days

calibration.uncalibrated_warning: Raw model output reflects scale_pos_weight ranking score; Platt calibrator outputs empirical 1-year decompensation risk.

low.label: Low Risk
low.clinical_action: Routine annual wellness monitoring; lifestyle support.

moderate.label: Moderate Risk
moderate.clinical_action: Biannual BP verification; ambulatory or home BP monitoring (ABPM); sodium reduction.

high.label: High Risk
high.clinical_action: Prompt clinical evaluation; medication adherence review; lifestyle intervention; close 90-day follow-up.

limitations: Synthetic EHR data only; does not contain real human patient clinical trajectories.
Low absolute event incidence (1.46% base rate) yields wide confidence intervals on test metrics.
Model trained on US-centric coding patterns and vital distributions; has NOT been clinically validated on Indian populations.
Not integrated with national health ID standards (ABDM/ABHA) or Indian clinical guidelines (e.g., API/IAP guidelines).
Wearable telemetry streams are strictly simulated demonstrations and decoupled from model weights.
Research prototype only; not certified as a medical device (CDSCO/FDA) and NOT for clinical diagnosis or treatment.
